The common runner gains candidate admission and selected-pin plumbing; its query, typed correction oracle, read/write loops, numerical gate function and default baseline path remain unchanged. The original single-patch diagnostics establish a plausible mechanism, not throughput or tail acceptance. The earlier source review's provenance-heavy global source-CTE limitation remains. A promising mixed result still needs the unchanged gates and appropriate fresh/reverse comparison before promotion.
